title: Nach Fund von Kameras in Damentoiletten – Durchsuchung bei Tatverdächtigem

extraction.placeName: Lichtenberger Campus der Hochschule für Wirtschaft und Recht
extraction.summaryEn: Police searched the flat of a 66-year-old man suspected of filming women in toilets at a university campus, after hidden cameras were found on 10 June 2026. The suspect was released after questioning and the investigation continues.
